note: A SIGNATURE CHANGE AND ITS CALL SITES CANNOT BE SEPARATE COMMITS here. The pre-commit hook runs make quick WORKSPACE-wide, so the intermediate state (type changed, callers not yet updated) does not compile and the hook rejects it -- and bypassing the hook is forbidden, correctly. The Ell hit this twice, at 36 files and 28 files in one commit each, and an earlier campaign lost a full round to it. Plan for it: size the task around the whole blast radius, say in the plan text that the size is FORCED rather than chosen, and drive the sweep off cargo check --workspace --all-targets --message-format=json rather than by hand. Watch the error count go 15, 8, 6, 8, 6, 5, 2, 79, 12, 6, 0 -- cargo only checks as far as the first broken crate per dependency chain, so a mid-sweep count is not progress and the 79 is simply where a big crate finally started compiling. Only zero means anything.
